title: Hajj pilgrims battle Mecca's scorching heat with ice cream and giant fans
summary: More than a million worshippers gathered in Mecca on Monday for the Hajj, the annual pilgrimage to Islam's holiest city, but the harsh heat has been brutal for many attendees.
